    for k in range(N + 1):

            x -= x & (-x)
        inv += seen - cnt
        x = v + 1
        while x <= size:
            tree[x] += 1
            x += x & (-x)
        seen += 1

    total += m * inv

import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0]); m = int(data[1])
    a = data[2:2+n]
    size = m
    tree_c = [0]*(size+1)
    tree_s = [0]*(size+1)

    def update(pos, val):
        # pos is residue in [0, m-1], index pos+1
        i = pos + 1
        while i <= size:
            tree_c[i] += 1
            tree_s[i] += val
            i += i & (-i)

    def query(pos):
        # sum of residues <= pos
        i = pos + 1
        c = 0; s = 0
        while i > 0:
            c += tree_c[i]
            s += tree_s[i]
            i -= i & (-i)
        return c, s

    total_c = 0
    total_s = 0
    ans = 0
    # insert S_0 = 0
    update(0, 0)
    total_c = 1
    total_s = 0
    prefix = 0
    for j in range(n):
        prefix = (prefix + int(a[j])) % m
        b = prefix
        c_le, s_le = query(b)
        c_gt = total_c - c_le
        s_gt = total_s - s_le
        ans += b * c_le - s_le + (s_gt - b * c_gt) + m * c_gt
        update(b, b)
        total_c += 1
        total_s += b

    print(ans)
